Container.Name: denonmusic-server
Container.Overview: Headless control server for a Denon/HEOS receiver. Owns the receiver's control connections and offers an HTTP API for search, queueing, transport and volume, for Home Assistant and a voice assistant. It queues and controls; the receiver reads the music itself. The image is built locally - see server/README.md in the denonmusic repository.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: The control API. Home Assistant talks to this.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the library search index is kept between restarts.

Config.Name: Receiver address
Config.Description: IP address or hostname of the receiver.

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Every request must send this in an X-Lan-Control-Token header. The server will not start without it.

Config.Name: Rebuild index at
Config.Description: Time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour, container time zone) to rebuild the search index. Leave empty for no schedule.

Config.Name: Rebuild index on days
Config.Description: Days for the scheduled rebuild, e.g. sun or mon,thu. Leave empty for every day.

Config.Name: Maximum volume
Config.Description: Ceiling (HEOS scale, 0-100) on what the API will set the volume to.

Config.Name: Volume step
Config.Description: How far 'volume up' and 'volume down' move.
